reason: A desktop chat plugin that lets models generate and edit images through configurable OpenAI-compatible APIs, then displays and manages the resulting attachments inline.

summaries.zh: 在桌面对话中通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容接口生成和修改图片，并以内联卡片方式显示和管理图片附件。
summaries.en: A desktop chat plugin for generating and editing images through configurable OpenAI-compatible APIs, with inline display and attachment management.

capabilities: Generates images through configurable OpenAI-compatible image APIs
Uploads reference images for image editing requests
Stores generated and uploaded images in local attachment storage
Provides local viewing, downloading, opening, and cleanup operations for image attachments
Uses a user-configured API key for external image generation requests
